evidence.title: Sir Dave Lewis Appointed as New CEO
evidence.summary: Diageo appointed Sir Dave Lewis as Chief Executive Officer effective 1 January 2026, following Debra Crew's departure and an interim period led by CFO Nik Jhangiani. evidence.quote: Fiscal 26 saw the appointment of a new Chief Executive Officer to lead the transformation of our business. evidence.title: Interim CEO Transition Period

initiatives.name: Tariff Mitigation and Contingency Planning
initiatives.summary: In response to US tariffs on UK and European imports estimated at c.$200 million annualised impact, Diageo undertook inventory management, supply chain optimisation, and re-allocation of investments to mitigate roughly half of the impact.

evidence.title: Tariff Mitigation Through Supply Chain Optimisation
evidence.summary: In response to US tariffs on UK and European imports estimated at c.$200 million annualised impact, Diageo undertook inventory management, supply chain optimisation, and re-allocation of investments to mitigate roughly half of the impact.
evidence.quote: As a result of our extensive supply chain and broad and advantaged portfolio, we have undertaken a number of actions to help mitigate the potential impact including inventory management, supply chain optimisation and re-allocation of investments. Given the actions to date and before any pricing, we expect to be able to mitigate around half of this impact on operating profit on an ongoing basis.

evidence.title: Tariff Contingency Planning for US Imports
evidence.summary: Diageo conducted considerable contingency planning regarding tariff implementation affecting UK, European, Mexican and Canadian spirits imports into the US, estimating unmitigated annualised impact and factoring this into FY26 guidance.
evidence.quote: Assuming the current 10% tariff remains on UK and 15% European imports into the US, that Mexican and Canadian spirits imports into the US remain exempt under the United States - Mexico - Canada Agreement (USMCA), and that there are no other changes to tariffs, the unmitigated impact of these tariffs is estimated to be c.$200 million on an annualised basis.
